title: TensorSpine Editor Layout Sidecar 1
description: What the editor's canvas knows about a model document and the document may not carry: positions, collapsed groups, the viewport, a template's preview assignment and the expanded view's filters. It is the editor's own file, written beside the document as `<model>.layout.json`; no tool of the repository reads it, and a document shared without it lays out automatically.

schema.description: The format of this file, as a tagged constant, so that a later revision is told from this one by reading rather than by guessing.

positions.description: A manual move, by the document path of the node it is about. Automatic layout is the default, so an entry here is an override; a key that names a place the document no longer has is dropped when the document is opened, with a line in the log.

collapsed.description: The document paths of the groups drawn collapsed. A composition is collapsed by default at the top level, so this list records what the user changed, not what is on screen.

viewport.description: Where the canvas was looking when the document was last open.

preview_assignment.description: The assignment a template document is previewed under: a value per external quantity, in the shape the tools' `--assign` takes. It is the editor's preview and not part of the document, which is saved without it. It is not dropped against the document: a name the document does not declare is ignored by the tools' own assignment check, so a stale entry costs nothing and a quantity that comes back finds its value.

expanded_view.description: What the read-only expanded view (the D1 graph) shows.

identifier.description: A name of the language, as the model schema writes one.

document_path.description: A place in the document, as its steps joined by slashes: `instances/embed`, `compositions/decoder/instances/attn`, `interfaces/inputs/tokens`. A step is a member name or an array index; the document's root has no key, since nothing is positioned at the document itself.

position.description: A place on the canvas, in the canvas's own coordinates.

scalar_literal.description: A value of a quantity, of the three kinds a literal source admits.

index_range.description: A range of one composition index, both bounds optional: what the expanded view is filtered to.

families.description: The families the view is restricted to; absent, every family is shown.

indices.description: A range per composition index the view is restricted to.
